_comment: Entity allow-lists, enforced by PocketQuests on EntityJoinLevelEvent.
A listed entity pattern may exist ONLY in the listed dimensions and is refused everywhere
else. An entity matching no pattern is never touched.
This is what makes a Horror pocket dimension possible at all: mods are global in the hub, so
without this the Cave Dweller and ArPhEx's bestiary would stalk you in the skyblock pocket
dimension and in the hub itself. Note that each real dimension is a separate id - the horror
nether and end are listed explicitly, or the mobs would be confined to the overworld only.
A trailing * wildcards, so arphex:* covers 147 entities without naming them.
